source_audit_completed.javascript: All root and www JavaScript files were inventoried. The production page loads the 18 scripts listed in www/index.html; www/app.js is the state/render/event-binding core.

testability_gaps: No data-testid attributes found in the production entry or application JavaScript.
The existing Playwright config has no baseURL/webServer, one HTML reporter, desktop projects only, and no package scripts.
Existing tests consist of one absolute-URL body-visibility check and a minimal BasePage.

preconditions: Coder must re-run git status and preserve all pre-existing uncommitted changes.
Coder must inspect the current production source before implementation; do not rely solely on this snapshot.
Use a local static server that serves www/ with SPA-safe navigation where required. Do not test the root legacy index as the production application.
Every test starts from an isolated storage state seeded only through fixture utilities; no test may depend on another test's persisted data.

implementation_steps.name: Establish Playwright runtime and artifact policy
actions: Add explicit scripts for headed/headless, smoke, regression, visual, accessibility and CI execution.
Configure a local server for www/, a relative baseURL, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit plus one Android-like and one iPhone-like project.
Configure HTML, JSON and JUnit reporters; retain-on-failure screenshots, video and trace; CI retries and bounded workers; output paths that remain ignored.
Do not overwrite unrelated package configuration or generated artifacts.
acceptance: npx playwright test --list discovers the suites without an absolute hard-coded URL.
Artifacts are emitted only under ignored output directories.

implementation_steps.name: Build isolated fixtures, helpers, data, and utilities
actions: Create typed/structured fixture modules for a fresh app, seeded localStorage state, page-error capture, console/network diagnostics and deterministic clock/data where safe.
Provide seeded factories for workouts, routines, food entries, profile/body entries, habits and goals using only verified storage schemas.
Provide helper APIs for navigation, dialog handling, offline contexts, localStorage/IndexedDB cleanup in the dedicated test context, screenshots and performance marks.
Provide test metadata/tagging and a capability registry that records native-only/not-implemented coverage explicitly.
acceptance: Parallel tests cannot read or mutate another test's state.
Seed data matches current storage readers and produces no app console error.

implementation_steps.name: Implement Page Object Model for verified screens
actions: Replace/extend BasePage with lifecycle, navigation, dialog, accessibility and diagnostic primitives.

Create page objects only for verified screen groups: Home/Dashboard, Workout, Plan, Exercise Library, Nutrition, Body/Profile, Progress, Health/Health Hub, Insights, Settings, Tools, AI Coach, Goals, uploads and bloodwork.
Use role, label, control association and existing data attributes. Add minimal production data-testid attributes only for dynamic/repeated controls that otherwise cannot be distinguished safely.
Model subviews such as workout builder/active session/history, calculator/body-photo views, Progress detail views and Health/backup fallbacks as component objects, rather than duplicating page code.
acceptance: Page objects do not encode unverified features or native implementation claims.
Selector additions do not change UI, storage schema, or runtime behaviour.

implementation_steps.name: Create functional coverage modules
actions: Implement smoke and navigation coverage for every reachable verified top-level screen and back/close paths.

Implement Workout coverage for routines, exercise selection/search/filter only where present, active-session edits, timers with controlled clock, saving/finishing, history, summary and safely scoped persistence. Exercise replacement/reordering/duplicate/favourite/PR assertions are conditional on verified controls.
Implement Nutrition coverage for food logging, macro/water totals, goals, favourites/history only when rendered. Barcode scanning is a documented N/A unless source evidence is found.

Implement Body/Profile and Progress coverage for logging/history, calculators, habits, charts/calendar/statistics/PRs where present; photos/uploads use synthetic in-memory files and isolated IndexedDB.

Implement web fallback coverage for Health, Settings, auth/cloud/backup UI state. Native Health Connect, Google sign-in, permissions, real backup, export/share and notification actions are skipped with a precise real-device reason rather than claimed as passed.
acceptance: Every asserted feature is evidenced by source and UI behaviour.
No test deletes or resets user-originated data.
Conditional tests report skipped/N/A honestly when the control is absent.

implementation_steps.name: Add cross-cutting quality suites
actions: Add keyboard/focus/order/labels/touch-target assertions. Integrate an accessibility scanner only if it is explicitly added to dependencies and its known limitations are documented.

Add repeatable local performance budgets for initial render, route transition, workout list with verified seeded volume, chart render and offline reload; collect metrics but avoid flaky internet-dependent budgets.

Add controlled visual snapshot baselines for representative Dashboard, Workout, Library, Nutrition, Progress, Health and Settings states in Chromium. Mask dynamic dates/timers and require an intentional baseline-review workflow.
Add responsive overflow/no-horizontal-scroll checks at the two configured mobile viewport sizes.
acceptance: Visual tests use deterministic data and reviewed baselines.
Performance results are recorded as local browser measurements, not device/perceived performance claims.

implementation_steps.name: Harden GitHub Actions and documentation
actions: Use npm ci, install Playwright browsers, run the CI project/tag selection, and upload HTML report, JSON/JUnit results, failure screenshots/videos/traces with retention.
Avoid triggering workflow changes on unrelated branches unless existing repository policy supports it.
Document local prerequisites, commands, projects/tags, seeded-data policy, artifact locations, snapshot update review, known browser/native boundaries and CI behaviour.
acceptance: Workflow uses the same scripts/config as local CI execution.
Reports and diagnostics are downloadable on both pass/failure as appropriate.

implementation_steps.name: Coder initial verification and handoff
actions: Run the focused and full browser suites once; report exact counts, retries, skipped native-only cases, console/page errors and artifact locations.
Run a smoke check in each configured engine only after selectors/fixtures are stable. Do not represent browser fallback coverage as native verification.
Record all modified files, test commands and untested risks.
acceptance: Handoff is ready for independent Playwright testing, not self-approval.

required: Run smoke/navigation and changed functional suites against the locally served www application.
Verify localStorage and IndexedDB isolation/persistence with synthetic data only.
Check page errors, console errors, failed requests and responsive horizontal overflow.
Run focused accessibility, visual and performance checks where deterministic baselines/budgets are committed.
Write exact PASS/FAIL/SKIP evidence to ai-workflow/TEST_RESULTS.json.
explicit_exclusions: Real Health Connect sync or health records

regression_risks: Tests touching localStorage keys may corrupt data if isolation is incorrectly implemented.
Full-app re-rendering can make dynamic selectors/focus assertions flaky; page objects must wait for actual state, not arbitrary timeouts.
Timers, dates, service worker cache and IndexedDB can make visual/performance tests nondeterministic.
Native fallback UI must not be mistaken for validation of its Android implementation.
Adding test IDs to the large app renderer risks accidental malformed markup or event-binding regressions; keep additions narrow and regression-test navigation.
forbidden_changes: No application redesign, demo app, placeholder page or fabricated feature.
No deletion/reset/renaming of existing user data or persistent keys.
No broad test-only changes to runtime logic; data-testid additions must be minimal and behaviour-neutral.
No direct commit/push, native build, dependency upgrade outside framework needs, or changes to Health Connect dependency version 1.1.0.
definition_of_done: Requested framework structure exists and is documented, with no duplicate test logic.
Configured projects/reports/artifacts/CI work from the same repository commands.
Page objects and data factories represent only verified application capabilities.
Independent browser evidence is recorded in TEST_RESULTS.json.
Final reviewer compares this request, this plan, git diff, implementation report and independent evidence before issuing exactly APPROVED, REJECTED, REQUIRES_REAL_DEVICE_TESTING or BLOCKED.
